name: Cafe Rio / Costa Vida Style Sweet Pork Burrito (Gut-Safe Mod)
whyItWorks: Slow-braised pork shoulder falls apart into gelatinous, zero-friction strands wrapped in a soft white flour tortilla.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order white flour tortilla + white rice + sweet shredded pork + melted Jack cheese. Skip whole black/pinto beans, raw lettuce, and pico de gallo.
